Sam: I'll post a 30s timer ping in lobby doc. Also: add a single-line host script for fallback: "We're swapping to a recorded clip for smooth playback; transcript + video will be posted in chat." Copyable.
Marta: Stage ops: spotlight demo, mute attendees, pin deck. If fallback triggered, post transcript link and play 3-min clip from /assets/fallback_clips/clip_short.mp4.
